artikelen.titel: More than 135 million people in Europe set for temperatures over 35C
artikelen.beschrijving: Europe is the fastest-warming continent in the world and in some places is ill-equipped to deal with hot weather.

artikelen.titel: Israel trucks out Gaza’s rubble to ‘hide genocide’ and ‘redraw the map’
artikelen.beschrijving: Israel carts away Gaza's rubble to destroy war crimes evidence and make the landscape unliveable, rights groups say.

artikelen.titel: Civilian deaths in Ukraine in July hit highest level since May 2022: UN
artikelen.beschrijving: At least 437 civilians were killed and 2,610 injured in Ukraine in July, the UN Human Rights Monitoring Mission said.

artikelen.beschrijving: Israel, which hosted the contest in 2019, will no longer be allowed to do so - but can still compete, protesters say.

artikelen.titel: Japan protests as Russia’s Putin visits disputed Kuril Islands
artikelen.beschrijving: Japanese PM says Putin's visit to the Pacific island chain, seized by the Soviet Union in 1945, is 'unacceptable'.
